title: 晚餐聚会中自然闲聊
subtitle: Remembering names and keeping a friendly conversation going

audio.title: Meeting people at a dinner
audio.note: 完整音频约 1分19秒，今天听完整段。已实际打开来源页，验证音频可播放、播放进度、时长及配套 Transcript。第一遍先不要展开原文；完整 Transcript 在来源页的 Transcript 标签中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕听力｜抓人物关系和名字误会（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开来源页，播放完整 1分19秒，第一遍不要展开 Preparation、Transcript 或下面的辨音提示。

第一遍：不中断，只判断这是初次见面、老朋友重逢，还是工作会议。
第二遍：只记人名、人物关系和地点关键词，例如 Julian、Alyssa、Ben、sister、wedding、castle。漏词也继续，不要在脑中逐句翻译。
第三遍：完成两道主旨题，再估计第一次无字幕听懂比例。之后才能进入精听。第三方原文只短提示一句：‘Do you remember Alyssa?’
questions: Charles 怎样帮助 Julian 想起 Alyssa？A. 提到 Ben 的婚礼 B. 展示工作照片 C. 介绍她的公司
Julian 犯了什么小错误？A. 忘记带饮料 B. 把 Alyssa 叫成 Alison C. 说错婚礼月份
sections.answers:
1. A。Charles 提到 Alyssa 是 Ben 的妹妹，他们都参加过 Ben 的婚礼。
2. B。Julian 把 Alyssa 的名字误叫成 Alison，随后道歉并说对了名字。

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
把完整音频再听两遍。每处按“先听 → 暂停模仿两次 → 看提示 → 关文本重听”练习。

① How are you?｜are 常弱读 /ə/，How_are 会自然连接，重音落在 How 和 you。
② Do you remember Alyssa?｜Do you 常连得接近 /dəjə/，remember 与 Alyssa 更清楚。
③ Would you like a drink?｜Would you 常连得接近 /wʊdʒə/；a 很轻，重音落在 like、drink。

最后关掉全部文字，重听 1分19秒并跟读一轮。先模仿一个意群的节奏，再尝试替换人名和饮料。
questions: Do you 在自然语流中可能听起来接近什么？
Would you like a drink? 中哪些词承担主要重音？

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜从记错名字到聊得自然（4分钟）
sections.body: Lena went to a small dinner at her friend Sam's flat. She knew Sam well but had never met most of the other guests. Sam introduced her to a man called Daniel. Lena thought his name was David, so she used the wrong name when she said hello. Daniel smiled and corrected her gently. Lena apologised, repeated his name and then asked, “How do you know Sam?” Daniel said they had worked together three years earlier. Instead of searching for perfect sentences, Lena listened for key words and asked one follow-up question at a time. They talked about their jobs, a local café and their plans for the weekend. When Lena missed a detail, she asked Daniel to say it again. The conversation soon felt easy. Before dinner started, Daniel introduced Lena to another guest. Remembering one name, asking simple questions and listening calmly helped her become part of the group.
questions: What did Lena do after using the wrong name?
How did she keep the conversation going without perfect English?
sections.translation: 莉娜去朋友萨姆的公寓参加一个小型晚餐。她很熟悉萨姆，却从未见过大多数其他客人。萨姆把一位名叫丹尼尔的男士介绍给她。莉娜以为他叫大卫，所以打招呼时叫错了名字。丹尼尔微笑着温和地纠正她。莉娜道歉、重复了他的名字，然后问：“你是怎么认识萨姆的？”丹尼尔说他们三年前曾一起工作。莉娜没有费力寻找完美句子，而是听关键词，并且一次问一个追问。两人聊了工作、当地一家咖啡馆和周末计划。莉娜漏掉一个细节时，请丹尼尔再说一遍。谈话很快变得轻松。晚餐开始前，丹尼尔又把莉娜介绍给另一位客人。记住一个名字、问简单问题并平静倾听，帮助她融入了这个群体。
sections.answers:
1. She apologised, repeated Daniel's name and asked how he knew Sam.
2. She listened for key words, asked one follow-up question at a time and requested repetition when needed.

sections.title: 4. 高频词块｜让闲聊继续下去（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Nice to meet you.｜很高兴认识你。｜Nice to meet you, Daniel. 很高兴认识你，丹尼尔。
2. How do you know ...?｜你怎么认识……？｜How do you know Sam? 你怎么认识萨姆？
3. Do you remember ...?｜你还记得……吗？｜Do you remember our first dinner here? 你还记得我们第一次在这里吃饭吗？
4. We met at ...｜我们在……见过。｜We met at Ben's wedding. 我们在本的婚礼上见过。
5. What do you do?｜你做什么工作？｜What do you do, Lena? 莉娜，你做什么工作？
6. What are you doing this weekend?｜你这周末做什么？｜What are you doing this weekend? 你这周末有什么安排？
7. Would you like a drink?｜你想喝点什么吗？｜Would you like a drink before dinner? 晚餐前想喝点什么吗？
8. Here you are.｜给你。｜Here you are—one glass of water. 给你，一杯水。
9. follow-up question｜追问｜A follow-up question keeps the chat going. 一个追问能让聊天继续。
sections.answers: 优先记住 8 个词块：Nice to meet you. / How do you know ...? / Do you remember ...? / We met at ... / What do you do? / What are you doing this weekend? / Would you like a drink? / Here you are.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜Do you remember ...? 与简短回答（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 Do you remember + 名词/人物/事件？询问对方是否记得。肯定简答用 Yes, I do；否定简答用 No, I don't。不要回答 Yes, I remember do。

例句 1：Do you remember Alyssa? — Yes, I do. 你记得艾丽莎吗？——记得。
例句 2：Do you remember the wedding? — No, I don't. 你记得那场婚礼吗？——不记得。
questions: 完成简答：Do you remember Ben? — Yes, I ___.
把句子改成一般疑问句：You remember the old castle.
sections.answers:
1. do
2. Do you remember the old castle?

sections.title: 6. 对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话
A: Hi, I'm Lena. Nice to meet you.
B: Nice to meet you too. I'm Daniel.
A: How do you know Sam?
B: We worked together a few years ago. How about you?
A: Sam and I went to university together. What do you do?
B: I work in design. What are you doing this weekend?
A: I'm visiting a new café with a friend.

替换练习
① worked together → played badminton together；a few years ago → last year。
② went to university together → live in the same building；work in design → work in sales。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 对方把你叫成错误名字：Actually, my name is Lena.
2) 想知道对方怎么认识主人：How do you know Sam?
3) 想把话题转到周末：What are you doing this weekend?

30–60 秒口头任务：假设你在朋友家的晚餐聚会认识新朋友。介绍自己，问对方怎样认识主人，再问工作或周末计划，并自然回应一次。不要先逐句翻译中文。
sections.answers: 示例：Hi, I'm Lena. Nice to meet you. How do you know Sam? Oh, you worked together? That sounds interesting. What do you do now? I'm in marketing. What are you doing this weekend?

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个礼貌拒绝词块：
1. Thanks for inviting me.｜谢谢你邀请我。
2. I'd love to, but ...｜我很想去，但是……
3. Maybe another time?｜要不改天？

快速串联：Thanks for inviting me. I'd love to, but I'm busy tonight. Maybe another time?

请回原聊天告诉我：① 今天第一次无字幕听懂了约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成晚餐闲聊任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个闲聊词块，并在 30–60 秒内完成“自我介绍＋人物关系＋工作或周末追问”。
